note: Reads the reader's LinkedIn home feed for the social-media agent. MILD by design (1 GET + up to 2 POSTs/day, human-paced) to avoid bot detection. LinkedIn moved the feed to RSC server-actions: the farmer GETs /feed/foryou for a FRESH pagination token + initial posts, then POSTs the pagination action for more. Extracts author + post-URL(topic slug) + text; drops sponsored. Engagement counts are NOT in the feed response (loaded per-post), so LinkedIn contributes content/author/topic, not engagement (that stays X-primary). PRIVATE: writes gitignored raw/linkedin/. Cookies (li_at + JSESSIONID) auto-read from the browser; falls back to li_cookies_path. Fragile by nature (RSC format changes) - fails safe with loud logs, never fakes.
